# Bundled fonts

These typefaces ship in `app/src/main/res/font/` so the journal never fetches fonts at runtime.

- Playfair Display — SIL Open Font License 1.1 (https://github.com/google/fonts)
- Inter — SIL Open Font License 1.1 (https://github.com/rsms/inter)
- IBM Plex Mono — SIL Open Font License 1.1 (https://github.com/IBM/plex)
